description: This file defines the IAppManager interface and related structures for managing applications within the WPEFramework Exchange namespace. It includes enums for app states and error reasons, a struct for runtime configuration, and a notification interface for app lifecycle events.

classes.name: RuntimeConfig
classes.description: Configuration structure for runtime parameters, including memory limits, environment variables, app paths, and debugging options.

classes.name: IAppManager
classes.description: Interface for application management, including methods for launching, closing, terminating apps, and managing app properties and states.

classes.name: IAppManager::LoadedAppInfo
classes.description: Structure holding information about a loaded application, including app ID, instance ID, session ID, type, and lifecycle states.

classes.name: IAppManager::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for app lifecycle events such as installation, uninstallation, state changes, launch requests, and unloading.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Register a notification interface for app events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregister a notification interface.

methods.name: GetInstalledApps
methods.description: Retrieve a list of all installed applications.

methods.name: IsInstalled
methods.description: Check if a specific application is installed.

methods.name: GetLoadedApps
methods.description: Retrieve a list of currently loaded applications.

methods.name: LaunchApp
methods.description: Launch an application, setting it to ACTIVE state.

methods.name: PreloadApp
methods.description: Preload an application, setting it to RUNNING state.

methods.name: CloseApp
methods.description: Close an application, moving it from Active to Running state.

methods.name: TerminateApp
methods.description: Terminate an application gracefully.

methods.name: StartSystemApp
methods.description: Start a system application.

methods.name: StopSystemApp
methods.description: Stop a system application.

methods.name: KillApp
methods.description: Forcefully kill an application.

methods.name: SendIntent
methods.description: Send an intent to a loaded application.

methods.name: ClearAppData
methods.description: Clear persistent data for a specific app.

methods.name: ClearAllAppData
methods.description: Clear persistent data for all applications.

methods.name: GetAppMetadata
methods.description: Retrieve metadata about an installed app.

methods.name: GetAppProperty
methods.description: Get a property value for a specific app.

methods.name: SetAppProperty
methods.description: Set a property value for a specific app.

methods.name: GetMaxRunningApps
methods.description: Get the maximum number of apps in running or suspended state.

methods.name: GetMaxHibernatedApps
methods.description: Get the maximum number of apps in hibernated state.

methods.name: GetMaxHibernatedFlashUsage
methods.description: Get the max flash size for hibernated apps (in MiB).

methods.name: GetMaxInactiveRamUsage
methods.description: Get the max RAM for inactive apps (in MiB).
